c6-science-ch08-t02-i09.prompt: Explain how water from the Bay of Bengal can end up as rain on a farm in Odisha.
c6-science-ch08-t02-i09.answer: The sun warms the sea water and it evaporates into water vapour; the vapour rises, cools and condenses into tiny droplets that form clouds; winds carry the clouds over land; the droplets join and fall as rain.

c7-science-ch11-t02-i09.prompt: In a traditional shadow-puppet show (like Tholu Bommalata of Andhra Pradesh), how does the puppeteer make a character seem to walk toward the audience and grow bigger?
c7-science-ch11-t02-i09.answer: By moving the puppet closer to the lamp and away from the screen, so the shadow on the screen grows; moving it back toward the screen shrinks it.
